items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Martin Burke, yeah. Mmm. That's good to me.

ctx.x: Yeah. Something like it's a... DM? Oh, I can't tell you what it is. They changed the name.
Did you know Marty Burke, the drummer? Somebody had mentioned him to me. Marty Burke?
Martin Burke, yeah. Mmm. That's good to me.
